title: Progress on coffee physics
body:
More progress on coffee physics in Odd Spark. The cup tips and coffee spills as I move the saucer to catch sugar cubes. Still a work in progress.

[video: Odd Spark gameplay showing the cup tipping and spilling coffee while catching sugar cubes.](../media/odd-spark-2026-09-27-progress-on-coffee-physics/progress-on-coffee-physics.mp4)
